status: Day 4 call sheet · Thursday 12 November · locations and interview duration to confirm
notices: Follows the supplied Day 4 call sheet prepared by Charita Films on 11 November 2026. All times are Santiago time (UTC−3); the schedule is subject to change.

Morning B-roll and the afternoon interview location are TBC. Production must confirm both locations, access and van pickup before navigation can be added. Lunch is in Providencia; no restaurant is specified.

Timing conflict in the source: interviews are described as maximum two hours including setup, but David's 10:15–13:00 setup/interview window is 2 hours 45 minutes and Hrvoj's 14:30–17:00 window is 2 hours 30 minutes. The published time blocks are retained; production must confirm the actual interview lengths and end times.
Leave the B-roll location at 10:00 to target 10:15 at Plaza Patricio Aylwin. This is a 15-minute call-sheet allowance, not a verified drive time; the B-roll location must fit that transfer.
Lunch is 13:00–14:00. Depart at 14:00 for the 14:30 setup and 15:00 interview. The 30-minute transfer cannot be checked until the afternoon location is confirmed.

Goran works conversationally without a fixed questionnaire. David is a Venezuelan sound professor and director living in Chile; his documentary Inmarchitables draws on his experience and the reality of Venezuela. Hrvoj is Honorary Consul of Croatia in Iquique.
17:00 is estimated wrap, not hotel arrival. Allow packing and loading before the return. Crew contacts and emergency contact details stay in the crew call sheet.
Checklists save only on this device and remain separate from the master B-roll list and other shooting days.
